title: Uhariri: (Theme 7: Sebuleni)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child reads his writing aloud with a finger under each word and checks four things on a card before the clean copy.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a sentence with a capital and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi kuhusu sebule yenu.

representations: an editing card with four checks
steps: Check for missing words and spelling.
contexts: sebuleni: a passage about the sitting room

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child finds and corrects two errors in his own sentence.

misconceptions.repair: Kuhariri ni kutafuta na kusahihisha makosa.

listen_for: Mama alipika chakula kitamu sana sana.
misconceptions.repair: Soma kwa sauti, neno kwa neno.
Angalia herufi kubwa mwanzoni na kikomo mwishoni.

listen_for: ninalifuta kwa nguvu au kulichora juu
misconceptions.repair: Piga mstari mmoja juu ya kosa, andika sahihi.
